name: hei5enbug-agent-setup
description: Portable agent skills for repeatable engineering and documentation workflows.

agent_guard.title: Block built-in subagents
agent_guard.description: Hide the built-in general-purpose, Explore, Plan, and claude agents and deny forked subagents so work goes to the plugin's scout and worker agents.

role_pinning.title: Pin role models
role_pinning.description: Run the scout, worker, sonnet-worker, designer, and reviewer agents on their pinned model and effort, and stop an agent that runs on any other model.

implementation_worker.title: Implementation worker
implementation_worker.description: Route implementation work: auto (the main session picks per task: haiku for easy work, sol for normal or hard work, sonnet when Codex usage is high), codex (Codex on gpt-5.6-luna at xhigh), haiku (the plugin worker on its Worker model and Worker effort, claude-haiku-5-5 at high by default), sol (gpt-6.1-sol at high through the role runner), or sonnet (the plugin sonnet-worker on claude-sonnet-5-5 at high).

worker_model.title: Worker model
worker_model.description: Model of the plugin worker agent in Claude Code. Takes effect after /reload-plugins or in a new session.

worker_effort.title: Worker effort
worker_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the plugin worker agent in Claude Code. Takes effect after /reload-plugins or in a new session.

codex_worker_model.title: Codex worker model
codex_worker_model.description: Model of the plugin worker role in Codex. Codex reads it at session start, so it takes effect from the next Codex session. HEI5ENBUG_CODEX_WORKER_MODEL overrides it.

codex_worker_effort.title: Codex worker effort
codex_worker_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the plugin worker role in Codex, from the next Codex session. HEI5ENBUG_CODEX_WORKER_EFFORT overrides it.

review_model.title: Review model
review_model.description: Model that runs independent validation and skill review roles at xhigh. GPT models run through codex exec and Claude models through claude -p.

language_guard.title: Response language guard
language_guard.description: Block or remind when a reply is not written in the configured response language.

datagrip_guard.title: DataGrip query guard
datagrip_guard.description: Run DataGrip reads without approval with a 60-second PostgreSQL limit; use the session write approval for writes and for every query on a data source marked as needing approval; ask every time for destructive queries.

approval_guard.title: Approval guard
approval_guard.description: Run covered CLI, script, database, and MCP reads without approval; ask once per session for writes, including production changes and git pushes, and reuse that approval for the rest of the session; reuse any other approved action for the session too, except force pushes, discarding uncommitted work, recursive deletion outside the session or temporary folders, destructive database statements, and remote infrastructure deletion, which ask every time; deny secret-printing commands and approval-state edits.

python.title: Hook Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path of a Python 3.12+ interpreter, with pglast for the SQL guard, that the plugin hooks use instead of python3; an empty or invalid value falls back to python3.
